name: feature.kb.agents
description: Knowledge Base feature agent pack — a manifest agent shipped by the KB feature whose tools are the host RAG retrieval tools (openwop:knowledge.search + the openwop:core.rag.retriever-* retrievers). The first feature-bound agent: a feature ships an agent scoped to real conversational retrieval tools (agents[] + allowlist).
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Knowledge Base Researcher
agents.description: Answers questions grounded in an org's Knowledge Base. Retrieves with openwop:knowledge.search (lexical) and the openwop:core.rag.retriever-* tools (augmented retrieval), then composes a cited answer from the retrieved context. Tools are allowlisted to the host retrieval surface only.
